summary: Selects and stores one of three constants into the global double at 0x5D6D70 based on the argument a1: a1==0 stores 1.0, a1==1 stores 30.0, a1==2 stores 0.119999997317791. Any other value leaves the global unchanged. Returns the decremented argument (a1-1, or a1-2 for the a1==2 path) as a side result.

operations.description: Initialize result to a1 before the branch chain.
Guard on a1 being zero: store 1.0 into the global double at 0x5D6D70.
Guard on a1 being 1: store 30.0 into the global double at 0x5D6D70.
Guard on a1 being 2: store 0.119999997317791 into the global double at 0x5D6D70.
Return the argument-derived value (a1-1 for a1==1, a1-2 for a1==2, else a1). Called by sub_4A00A0, VidMan_Restart (004FA640) and sub_4FA7E0.
